content: Yã́ pↄ́ gↄ̃̀ wá gbɛ̃́ↄ, à wabikɛwɛ̃ɛ Luawa kɛ́ Dii yã́ e ligua kpakpa, iↄ gawi vĩnɛ́ lá a vĩ á kĩ́iwa.
À wabikɛwɛ̃ɛ aà wá bↄ gbɛ̃vãi mìsaiↄ ↄzĩ, asa i kɛ gbɛ̃́pii mɛ́ Lua náai vĩo.
Dii náai vĩ, a á gba gbãa, i á sí Setãuwa.
Wá naa Diiwa guu wá a náai vĩ kɛ́ álɛ yã́ pↄ́ wá òɛ́ↄ kɛ, mɛ́ áↄ kɛɛ.
Dii tó á laai àↄ ku Lua yeaáziwa ń mɛna pↄ́ Kilisi ì inɛ́o.
Gbɛ̃́ↄ, wa naɛ́ Dii Yesu Kilisizi, à kɛ̃́ wá gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ màa vĩ aali zĩkɛ yã́ pↄ́ wá dànɛ́waoↄwa.
Á dↄ̃ ázĩawa, a maa à wá kɛa kɛɛ, asa màadeↄn wá ũ á guuo.
Wi gbɛ̃e blɛ si wá blè pão, wa zĩkɛ̀ gwãasĩna ń fãanɛo, wa taasikɛ̀ e wa kpasa, kɛ́ wásu gↄ̃ á gbɛ̃eɛ aso ũo yã́i.
Wá a zɛ́ vĩ à dↄwálɛ, ãma wa a taa kɛ̀ɛ́, kɛ́ à wá ↄlɛsɛɛ.
Gↄↄ pↄ́ wá kúánↄ, wá dìlɛ gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ ye zĩkɛaio a pↄbleo.
Wá mà á gbɛ̃eↄ màa vĩ, aali pↄe woo, sema gudɛ.
Wá dìlɛ gbɛ̃́ bee taaↄnɛ, wa nanɛ́ Dii Yesu Kilisizi, aali zĩkɛ kílikili aa ńzĩa gwa.
Ápiↄ sↄ̃ wá gbɛ̃́ↄ, ásu kpasa ń maakɛaoo.
Tó gbɛ̃e i yã́ pↄ́ wá òɛ́ lápi guu dao, à aà yã́ bↄ dilɛ. Ásu gbɛ̃́ kpaaànↄo, kɛ́ wí e aà kṹ.
Ãma ásu íbɛlɛsɛaànↄo, à lɛdawà á gbɛ̃do ũ.
Dii Aafiade á gba aafia gↄↄpii yã́pii guu. Dii àↄ kúánↄ ápii.
Ma Pↄlu mámɛ ma fↄɛ bee kɛ̃̀ ń mazĩa ↄo. Bee mɛ́ ma lá píi seela ũ, màa mi kɛ̃́.
Wá Dii Yesu Kilisi gbɛ̃kɛkɛɛ́ ápii.
